cases.name: Kaitlin Nichole Roberts
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She graduated from Linganore High School in 2007 and worked at Olive Garden in Winchester. When she wasn’t working, she loved spending time with her children. She also loved beaches, and visiting with family."

https://www.resthaven.us/obituary/Kaitlin-Roberts
cases.narrative: Her body was found in the roadway the intersection of English Muffin Court and English Muffin Way in Frederick. The Medical Examiner noted she had 32 stab wounds as well as abrasions from “road rash” due to being dragged by a vehicle.

cases.name: Dianna Lynne Swaner
cases.about: Her obituary said: "She worked and retired after 40 plus years of service for ZM Sheet Metal where she was a fabricator. She loved going to flea markets, yard sales, buying clothes and loved to buy the next car that caught her eye. Dianna always loved to donate and helped those who were less fortunate."
cases.narrative: He punched her, smashed her head through a TV, and fatally bludgeoned her with a jarred candle.
